source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Taking the place of any other hemorrhage risk assessment that a nurse would otherwise be expected to perform beforehand","B":"Rapid availability of compatible blood products if hemorrhage occurs, reducing delay in a time-critical emergency","C":"Applying mainly to clients who already have a known, previously diagnosed bleeding disorder before this pregnancy","D":"Offering fairly little meaningful advantage over simply waiting until an active hemorrhage has already begun to unfold"}}
source_row.rationale: Proactive type and crossmatch for clients at high risk for postpartum hemorrhage supports rapid availability of compatible blood products if hemorrhage occurs, reducing critical delay in this time-sensitive emergency.
source_row.source_detail: Benefit of Proactive Type and Crossmatch
source_row.stem: A nurse ensures a client at high risk for postpartum hemorrhage has blood type and crossmatch completed proactively before delivery. This practice supports:
